name: desktop-sidebar-topics
description: A pane listing the Claude Desktop sessions that are waiting for your answer, one click away.

intervalSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the list is refreshed, in seconds.

maxSessions.title: Sessions checked
maxSessions.description: How many recent sessions are checked on each refresh.

maxAgeDays.title: Max idle age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Sessions idle for longer than this are not checked.

debugFile.title: Debug file
debugFile.description: When set, each refresh writes what the pane lists to this file (troubleshooting only).
